claim_policy: This is a current literature-positioning audit, not proof of novelty. It supports a narrow proceed-with-caution framing and highlights prior-work risks that must be disclosed in any NeurIPS submission.

closest_prior_work.difference: CSRM-RAG must be framed as a selective risk detector and audit protocol over aligned evidence-set orbits, not as a new CoRM-RAG retriever.
closest_prior_work.overlap: Direct parent paper: counterfactual risk minimization for robust RAG and risk-aware abstention.
closest_prior_work.paper: Beyond Semantic Relevance: Counterfactual Risk Minimization for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation

closest_prior_work.difference: SURE-RAG focuses on sufficiency/uncertainty verification; CSRM-RAG novelty must come from counterfactual orbit stability and aligned perturbation evidence.
closest_prior_work.overlap: Closest sufficiency-verifier and selective-RAG abstention work.
closest_prior_work.paper: SURE-RAG: Sufficiency and Uncertainty-Aware Evidence Verification for Selective Retrieval-Augmented Generation

closest_prior_work.difference: It does not provide item-level counterfactual evidence-orbit risk estimation or aligned orbit ablations.
closest_prior_work.overlap: Defines sufficient context and uses sufficiency for guided abstention.
closest_prior_work.paper: Sufficient Context: A New Lens on Retrieval Augmented Generation Systems

closest_prior_work.difference: CF-RAG uses counterfactual query reasoning; CSRM-RAG must emphasize evidence-set orbit stability and selective risk under equal verifier budget.
closest_prior_work.overlap: Counterfactual queries and arbitration for robust RAG.

closest_prior_work.difference: Broader causal-counterfactual answer generation; not the same as calibrated orbit-level selective risk detection.
closest_prior_work.overlap: Causal and counterfactual reasoning integrated into RAG.
closest_prior_work.paper: Causal-Counterfactual RAG: The Integration of Causal-Counterfactual Reasoning into RAG

closest_prior_work.difference: Relevant to risk-control claims; current CSRM-RAG evidence is empirical and must not claim formal conformal coverage.
closest_prior_work.overlap: Robust factuality and calibration-style guarantees for RAG.
closest_prior_work.paper: Is Conformal Factuality for RAG-based LLMs Robust? Novel Metrics and Systematic Insights

core_claims.assessment: Plausible if positioned as orbit-level counterfactual stability rather than plain sufficiency.
core_claims.claim: Aligned evidence-set orbits expose fragile RAG items that clean sufficiency misses.

core_claims.assessment: Novelty depends on human-audited orbit labels and strong equal-budget baselines; current evidence is partial.
core_claims.claim: CSRM estimates selective item risk from orbit statistics under equal verifier-call budgets.

core_claims.assessment: Mechanism is defensible after shuffled-alignment ablation and formalization, but needs careful distinction from counterfactual-query methods.
core_claims.claim: Orbit alignment is a necessary mechanism for counterfactual selective RAG.

core_claims.assessment: Do not claim. Current FEVER evidence is negative at the 0.20 target.
core_claims.claim: CSRM provides formal/general risk control for robust RAG.
core_claims.closest_prior: Conformal factuality for RAG; CoRM-RAG risk-aware abstention

method_under_review: CSRM-RAG: counterfactual sufficiency stability and calibrated selective risk over aligned evidence-set orbits for robust RAG.
positioning: Frame the contribution as an audit-grade, leakage-controlled, aligned evidence-orbit selective-risk protocol built on top of CoRM-style critic scores. Avoid claiming a new retrieval paradigm, formal risk control, or all-win superiority.
required_to_upgrade: Complete the 1000-item Human Audit v4 labels and report human-label metrics.
Obtain API-backed LLM-judge baseline/correlation scores or remove LLM-judge claims.
Keep full CoRM-RAG reproduction unsupported until the storage/index artifacts are repaired.
Write related work around SURE-RAG, Sufficient Context, CF-RAG, and CoRM-RAG as closest neighbors.
